`@interface UIData`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.core.data` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [UIData.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/core/data/UIData.java)

Annotation that configures how a UI is drawn, receives the input and closes.

## Description

Put it on a [`UI`](/reference/ui/ui/) class; a subclass inherits it unless it declares its own.
JOID reads it into a [`UIDataObject`](/reference/annotations/uidataobject/), returned by [`UI.getData`](/reference/ui/ui/#UI-method-getData), whose setters change the options while the UI runs.

## Elements

| Type | Element | Default | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| `boolean` | [active](#UIData-element-active) | `true` | If `false`, the UI is drawn but receives no input, and the UIs below it receive the input instead. |
| `boolean` | [visible](#UIData-element-visible) | `true` | If `false`, the UI is neither drawn nor sent any input, and closing it skips its closing transition. |
| `boolean` | [closeable](#UIData-element-closeable) | `true` | If `false`, Escape leaves the UI open; [`JOID.close`](/reference/ui/joid/#JOID-method-close) still closes it. |
| `boolean` | [zoomable](#UIData-element-zoomable) | `true` | If `false`, the zoom keys (Ctrl or Alt with + and -, and Alt with the wheel in dev mode) leave the zoom of the UI unchanged. |
| `boolean` | [projection](#UIData-element-projection) | `true` | If `true`, the UI sets its own projection over the window; if `false`, it draws inside the projection that the host has set. |
| `boolean` | [background](#UIData-element-background) | `false` | If `true`, the UI draws the UI backdrop over the whole window, behind its nodes, in `backgroundColor`; the backdrop fades with the transition of the UI. |
| `String` | [backgroundColor](#UIData-element-backgroundColor) | `"#101010C0"` | Color of the UI backdrop, as a hexadecimal string `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA`. |
| `int` | [zindex](#UIData-element-zindex) | `0` | Order of the UI among the open UIs of its bridge: a higher value is drawn above and receives the input first. |
| `double` | [zlevel](#UIData-element-zlevel) | `0D` | Depth, along the Z axis, added before the UI is drawn, in the units of the projection of the host. |
| [`Align`](/reference/layout/align/) | [anchorX](#UIData-element-anchorX) | `Align.CENTER` | Side of the window that the canvas is pinned to when the window is wider than 16:9, and that the zoom keeps in place. |
| [`Align`](/reference/layout/align/) | [anchorY](#UIData-element-anchorY) | `Align.CENTER` | Side of the window that the canvas is pinned to when the window is taller than 16:9, and that the zoom keeps in place. |

## Element details

<a id="UIData-element-active"></a>

### active

`boolean active() default true` 

If `false`, the UI is drawn but receives no input, and the UIs below it receive the input instead.

<a id="UIData-element-visible"></a>

### visible

`boolean visible() default true` 

If `false`, the UI is neither drawn nor sent any input, and closing it skips its closing transition.

<a id="UIData-element-closeable"></a>

### closeable

`boolean closeable() default true` 

If `false`, Escape leaves the UI open; [`JOID.close`](/reference/ui/joid/#JOID-method-close) still closes it.
An overlay never closes with Escape.

<a id="UIData-element-zoomable"></a>

### zoomable

`boolean zoomable() default true` 

If `false`, the zoom keys (Ctrl or Alt with + and -, and Alt with the wheel in dev mode) leave the zoom of the UI unchanged.

<a id="UIData-element-projection"></a>

### projection

`boolean projection() default true` 

If `true`, the UI sets its own projection over the window; if `false`, it draws inside the projection that the host has set.

<a id="UIData-element-background"></a>

### background

`boolean background() default false` 

If `true`, the UI draws the UI backdrop over the whole window, behind its nodes, in `backgroundColor`; the backdrop fades with the transition of the UI.

<a id="UIData-element-backgroundColor"></a>

### backgroundColor

`String backgroundColor() default "#101010C0"` 

Color of the UI backdrop, as a hexadecimal string `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA`.

<a id="UIData-element-zindex"></a>

### zindex

`int zindex() default 0` 

Order of the UI among the open UIs of its bridge: a higher value is drawn above and receives the input first.

<a id="UIData-element-zlevel"></a>

### zlevel

`double zlevel() default 0D` 

Depth, along the Z axis, added before the UI is drawn, in the units of the projection of the host.

<a id="UIData-element-anchorX"></a>

### anchorX

`Align anchorX() default Align.CENTER` 

Side of the window that the canvas is pinned to when the window is wider than 16:9, and that the zoom keeps in place.

<a id="UIData-element-anchorY"></a>

### anchorY

`Align anchorY() default Align.CENTER` 

Side of the window that the canvas is pinned to when the window is taller than 16:9, and that the zoom keeps in place.
